rites.name: Tiarum
rites.text: A tactic in which a caster conjures many small spheres and hurls them in a storm at a chosen target. The volley wears the foe down through relentless impact.

rites.name: Amelles
rites.text: A fighter seizes a rival by the ankle and whirls them around in a wide arc before letting them fly free. It is a brute grappling maneuver used in combat.

rites.name: Valiarnasum Valanum
rites.text: A fire technique in which a blazing winged creature swoops down to scorch guardian warriors. It hits hardest against one particular fire-aligned defender.

rites.name: Taunollum
rites.text: A fighter pivots on one heel and whips a leg around in a backward arc to strike an opponent. It is a close-range strike used in a stone-age style combat art.

rites.name: Telintus
rites.text: A fighter performs an upside-down handstand and then kicks a foe, where a single forceful blow strikes harder than several light ones combined.

rites.name: Haluldath
rites.text: Haluldath is a concept within Venuala's Ki Realm, a principle of divine trial that the Courts of the Holy Age used to judge which doors between worlds could be safely opened. Its ritual flames were said to test the will of council members during the building of those thresholds.

rites.name: Siliraenae
rites.text: Siliraenae is a concept of Venuala, the principle that a sworn word may be bent into a door between worlds, and it was first named in the Courts during the Age of Sundering. It is remembered as the thread that held the old bonds steady while landfall broke them apart.

rites.name: Reorniantum
rites.text: A ward-craft strike that wears down enchantments and the protective sigils of a caster. It is wielded by a masked hunter who unravels spells in combat.

rites.name: Sirnanum
rites.text: A bladed gust of wind that a tempest-warrior hurls across a battlefield to cut down foes. It is a technique performed in a fighting ritual of the sky-sworn.

rites.name: Corianor
rites.text: A dark, churning wave of water that is unleashed by a warrior or sorcerer in battle. It is a strike drawn from the depths and used by two different fighters in their clashes.

rites.name: Raullor
rites.text: A swirling energy assault unleashed by a trio of wild huntresses during a stage performance. It strikes at false doubles and hollow puppets crafted to deceive.

rites.name: Orestes
rites.text: A keeper of the deep tides unleashes a rushing swell of sea-dwelling force that sweeps through foes. It is a strike wielded in a battle of spirit and water.

rites.name: Valiarnenia
rites.text: A purifying force channeled through sacred paper charms by a temple keeper who guards the realm. It is one of the first forceful techniques wielded by the guardian.

rites.name: Orisentium
rites.text: A jolting strike that a single fighter once unleashed in one particular contest. It hits with a sudden burst of force.

rites.name: Rines
rites.text: A ball-shaped strike that a band of four warrior sisters once used. It can shatter a person's mirror of dreams, stripping it away.

rites.name: Amistium
rites.text: A spoken command that makes a bearer's sacred gem shift from a heart form into a star form. The change lets the bearer join allied champions in a higher guardian state.

rites.name: Amostor
rites.text: A devastating final strike unleashed by a cosmic guardian, tearing apart everything nearby. It is performed in a great clash between the chosen champions of a celestial order.

rites.name: Seriasium
rites.text: A charm-based strike that lulls a rival into a trance. Several gods of the old temples are said to wield it against their foes.

rites.name: Teontium
rites.text: A dark, deathly cry that a guardian of the underworld unleashes as an attack. It draws on the powers of death and shadow to strike foes.

rites.name: Leontianium
rites.text: A water-borne technique in which a wielder rises from below, wrapped in a ring of great bubbles that strike several foes at once. It costs no reserve of strength but demands a precise gesture to unleash.

rites.name: Lastia
rites.text: A ritual working drawn through a small charm or staff, used by two travelers of time to bend hidden threads of magic. It is channeled through a companion relic when performed.

rites.name: Lirnum
rites.text: A wielder gathers pale night glow through a crimson crest set upon a circlet and hurls it as a focused ray at an opponent. In some tellings a rod carried in the hand serves as the channel for the same silver discharge.

rites.name: Relloses
rites.text: A water-borne technique that a sea-touched wielder unleashes using two linked focus stones. It bends the tide into a shimmering sweep that overwhelms foes.

rites.name: Serironum
rites.text: A moonlight-fueled technique wielded by a rod-bearing warrior, and a younger ally can join in to make the strike stronger.

rites.name: Sereostia
rites.text: A bearer calls forth golden plumes that rest upon the hair before striking an opponent with bursts of radiant light. The technique consumes a single shard of stored power.

rites.name: Vialenanum
rites.text: A stronger variant of a sorcerer's freezing art, said to hold the same chilling effects but with far greater force. Its power is only hinted at, never fully shown.

rites.name: Ceolostanum
rites.text: Two bonded wardens combine their heart-light through a shared pale staff, unleashing a radiant surge. The blast fuses a rose-tinted pulse with a dark-cloaked burst into one devastating wave.

rites.name: Serintum
rites.text: A mystic assault that appears only once in a single telling of a heroine's tale. It is a moonlit force drawn on by a sworn guardian in one dire moment.

rites.name: Valeoles
rites.text: A dark-hearted sorceress unleashes a great blast of sinister energy that wounds a company of celestial protectors. The surge strikes hardest against their bright leader.

rites.name: Meseonanum
rites.text: A whirling storm-rush of gathered air that a keeper sends from a crystal sphere toward a foe. Sages regard it as the signature technique of its wielder.

rites.name: Taullia
rites.text: A tide-caster draws water into a cool haze that drifts over foes and dulls their strength. The haze is loosed by a wielder who bends vapour to their will.

rites.name: Sosium
rites.text: A binding craft that traps foes inside a five-pointed sigil, a technique a sorcerer employs to ensnare the guardians of the realm.

rites.name: Rerilium
rites.text: A fiery strike that a sacred caster hurls at foes in an ancient rite of battle. It burns with flames drawn from the caster's inner heat.

rites.name: Corinus
rites.text: A swift, forceful strike performed with a body moving like rising heat. It is practiced by a single fighter in a sequence of fiery motions.

rites.name: Casia
rites.text: A radiant healing rite performed by a guardian maiden to restore those harmed by shadowy dominion. It appears in many retellings across different tellings of the tale.

rites.name: Tilus
rites.text: A coordinated frost assault in which a small circle of allied warriors joins hands and releases a single icy embrace. The combined cold freezes whatever it touches, and the technique appears across written tales and staged performances.

rites.name: Ceornaulium
rites.text: A deep-water maneuver drawn from the ocean's depths, used by a sea-bound guardian across all her forms. It pulls foes down beneath the waves.

rites.name: Oreolium
rites.text: A fighter drives a flaming heel downward onto an opponent in a single blow. The strike combines scorching heat with raw physical force.

rites.name: Oriaranum
rites.text: A cold blue flame that a caster hurls at a foe to pin them in place. It is strong enough to rival a rival's fire, though a stronger inferno can overpower it.

rites.name: Rines Vaunum
rites.text: A temple-trained warding technique that a sorceress of the western orders can unleash to strike her foes. It is wielded as a formidable offensive art.

rites.name: Teliasia
rites.text: A ruinous working of the highest order, wielded by the god of annihilation. It is the strongest strike that such a deity can unleash.

rites.name: Corintanum
rites.text: A protective ward drawn from a crimson sphere that raises a shield around those standing close. It was used once to guard a small group from falling rubble.

rites.name: Mallus
rites.text: A desperate close-combat strike where a robed guardian lunges at a foe, then pummels them repeatedly before finishing with a rising blow from a staff.

rites.name: Nallanum
rites.text: A fiery technique wielded by a temple guardian, who summons a churning tempest of flame to strike foes. It is a signature assault of her order.

rites.name: Oreoleres
rites.text: A stronger form of an old dark-water rite, performed by a single wielder in one rare moment. It surges with deep river power once and is never seen again.

rites.name: Meollesus
rites.text: A bewitched bloom-spirit draws a waking root from the earth and hurls it at a foe. The strike is a practiced ritual of its kind.

rites.name: Coreostia
rites.text: A devastating frost assault in which a caster summons shards of ice that plummet from the heavens onto a group of defenders. One defender in particular tends to be hit hardest.

rites.name: Coraneria
rites.text: A dark-handed strike used by a sorceress against a masked champion who arrives on the scene. He answers it with a smoking bomb that drives her off.

rites.name: Nileostus
rites.text: A ritual flame technique wielded by a sworn guardian of the temple order. It is said to pass unchanged through every retelling of the old legends.

rites.name: Oreollium
rites.text: A dark ruler unleashes a volley of crackling lightning, first in scattered bolts and then in heavier strikes that hammer each warrior in turn. The fiercest blows fall upon the sturdiest of the defenders.

rites.name: Lareonum
rites.text: A keeper of still waters draws a strong current from the sea and hurls it forward in a single rushing stream. It is a rare technique, seen only once in the chronicles of the order.

rites.name: Miastaunor
rites.text: A combat technique in which a fighter sets off a line of linked charges one after another. The chain of blasts overwhelms the foe and marks a single warrior's signature strike.

rites.name: Tiantus
rites.text: A whirling bloom-storm called upon by a warrior to strike foes with a spinning gust of petals. It appears across many tellings of her deeds.

rites.name: Seresium
rites.text: A desperate charging strike used in a warrior's final stand. The attacker rushes at a foe and, on contact, pummels them again and again before ending with a plunging finishing blow.

rites.name: Maleontium
rites.text: A coiled, shadowy force that hostile wielders call upon to strike at their foes. It was first unleashed in a staged drama of an alternate tale.

rites.name: Saurnus
rites.text: A heart-fueled technique unleashed by a small, radiant guardian that strikes several foes at once. It draws on a warm, aching energy to overwhelm a whole group of enemies in one blow.

rites.name: Vania Meolor
rites.text: Two gazing sorcerers hurl a reflected shadow that turns back an opposing blast. It appears once in a grand staged performance, where it blocks the rival duo's signature assault.

rites.name: Serasor Taules
rites.text: A glowing chain of bound light woven from stored energy, used as a strike in combat. It is a variant of an older binding technique, reshaped by changing the word spoken to call it forth.

rites.name: Lentolia
rites.text: A binding technique in which a trained caster snares an enemy with a flowing band of woven light. The loop tightens to disarm and bring down foes.

rites.name: Serauntes
rites.text: A coordinated strike performed by sworn guardian circles during a rare ritual surge. It is unleashed by a set of linked defenders working together as one force.

rites.name: Orialles Vaustallia
rites.text: A radiant strike of stored energy that a band of four guardians unleashes on the stage of a sung performance. It is used only in those staged shows and first appeared in a mountain-forest tale of battle.

rites.name: Coranternes
rites.text: A bodily blow taught to a young warrior in a sacred hall. It resembles a famous leaping kick and is first used to overcome a rival who corrupts a gaming shrine.

rites.name: Ameonus
rites.text: A coordinated burst of energy is unleashed by a circle of guardian warriors acting together. It is performed in every telling of the tale.

rites.name: Oseivsith
rites.text: Oseivsith is the concept of the Weave-planting, the moment in Venuala's Seeding when makers sow the threads that will hold quiet powers asleep. In the Holy Age it is worshipped as a flame that never goes out, its temples keeping the Weave's rhythm alive. It is less a force than a promise the orders swear to keep.

rites.name: Ameoliastia
rites.text: A lunar strike is unleashed from the sky by a royal figure of the moon. It falls upon a sorcerous creature and destroys it.

rites.name: Valernor
rites.text: A soaring double kick delivered by two allied warriors moving as one. It is an enhanced form of an older single strike from the same martial tradition.

rites.name: Mistor
rites.text: A guardian's sacred stone is said to shift from a heart shape into a star shape, a change that calls on a shared power to empower allies in a decisive moment against a dark ruler.

rites.name: Senus
rites.text: A gate-channeled strike that a sorceress called Ceyra unleashes across a battlefield in the animated saga. It opens a passage through which force is hurled at a foe.

rites.name: Coraustum
rites.text: A swift physical technique that a water-aligned warrior uses to attack with great speed. It is carried out in the fights of a gaming world and is linked to one specific fighter.

rites.name: Miarnales
rites.text: A ruling anthem sung by a self-proclaimed star-queen and her followers during theatrical performances. It celebrates her absolute command over the people who chant it.

rites.name: Telastanum
rites.text: A radiant striking technique used by a warrior in her heroic guise to hit her foe with physical force. It belongs to the arts of a champion of the sky.

rites.name: Saurnium
rites.text: A warrior raises an arm and sends four sacred paper charms spinning into a protective ring that strikes several foes at once. The strike drains her inner strength only when it lands.

rites.name: Reranum
rites.text: A spell that swaps the ages of two chosen targets, so each takes on the other's years. It has been cast only once, by a sorceress in the tale.

rites.name: Rialus
rites.text: A transformed-limb power granted to two twin sisters by a shadowy spirit. It lets its wielders take on a beast-like form with their hands.

rites.name: Orirus
rites.text: A practitioner summons a ring of rising water that encloses a foe in a rotating pool. The pool then bursts outward, shattering the target.

rites.name: Mineolus
rites.text: A guardian's spoken phrase that reshapes a sea-bright gem from heart form into a star, letting her join allies in a transformation that supports a healing kiss against a dark queen.

rites.name: Sorenor
rites.text: A grappling strike used once by a fighter against an elder. A young heroine interrupts it before its full force lands.

rites.name: Telarnosium
rites.text: A spoken command that lets a wielder change their appearance into several different guises. The wielder speaks the word and takes on a disguise.

rites.name: Leolum
rites.text: A wielder plays a resonant instrument to call forth a surging wave of water that overwhelms foes. It is the strongest single technique of its user.

rites.name: Telanor
rites.text: A rallying chant sung in unison by a company of heroic protectors before they enter the fray. Its bright refrain steels their resolve and gives them courage when the battle begins.

rites.name: Amiastes Valaunanum
rites.text: A shared incantation spoken by ten guardians that lets them all change their form together. Its words call the group into one collective transformation.

rites.name: Lialisor
rites.text: A warrior strikes downward with a single decisive blow that shatters a hidden engine of a shadowy guild, which drains life from ordinary folk through a playful contraption. The strike is a plain falling chop.

rites.name: Valia
rites.text: A closing incantation spoken by a young fighter that transforms her into a storm-wielding defender. It marks the final step of her change into guardian form.

rites.name: Valarnisus
rites.text: A spoken incantation that lets a small feline guardian change into her warrior form through a handheld device. The change is shown with playful cat-like gestures and a glowing transformation sequence, and it appears only in one chronicle.

rites.name: Cauntus
rites.text: A shared chant rises when two companions try to lift the spirits of two others. The four voices blend together in a single uplifting refrain.

rites.name: Varanum
rites.text: A coordinated strike unleashed by a band of guardian fighters during a stage performance. It draws on their shared spirit to hit a foe with overwhelming force.

rites.name: Volus
rites.text: A paralyzing technique wielded by a sorceress in staged performances. It locks her foes in place so they cannot move.

rites.name: Siasium
rites.text: A guardian lifts a heart-shaped gem into a star shape, awakening a radiant transformation. Her allies join her light to empower a healing kiss that overthrows a sorceress queen.

rites.name: Saurnisanum
rites.text: A ruinous strike of ending power that a wielder unleashes with a sacred blade against a tyrant, marking a climax of the struggle.

rites.name: Lisum
rites.text: A second spoken invocation that a young heroine uses to shift into her armored guardian form. It is recognized across written tales, animated shows, and a later revival of the story.

rites.name: Tania
rites.text: A spoken invocation that a young woman speaks while holding a slender writing instrument, which transforms her into a masked heroine. The words serve as the trigger for the change.

rites.name: Valestor
rites.text: A rose-hued sphere swells outward to swallow a foe, reducing them to bone in moments. Its cost is severe, and it erases the memories of those who wielded it.

rites.name: Riantastus
rites.text: A bodily strike performed by a thunder-born warrior who must spend a single glowing shard to unleash it. The blow rises from the ground in a sweeping arc.

rites.name: Vontillia
rites.text: A gentle strike that circles above its targets and scatters glittering motes over them. The motes undo a hollowing curse, restoring those who were enthralled.

rites.name: Leontanum
rites.text: A ranged strike of radiant energy unleashed by a rival sorceress against a band of defenders. It rains bright force down upon its targets from above.

rites.name: Celaurnia
rites.text: A single watery assault is unleashed by a sea-keeper wielding a ringed drum-shield. It is struck once against a shadow-beast before it is never seen again.

rites.name: Oreostanum
rites.text: A healing sphere of restorative light hurled by a wielder who carries a green gem. It was stopped by a shielding barrier cast by an ally.

rites.name: Niarnum
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a wearer chants to hide their true form behind a borrowed guise. In some tellings it is woven into a pocket device that every member of a sworn band carries.

rites.name: Taror
rites.text: A young user bounces a small companion creature across an open field and calls out a phrase. The companion rises and turns into a chosen object within a burst of rosy vapor, then reverts the same way when no longer needed.

rites.name: Serasiarnum Maulles
rites.text: A bodily assault wielded by a silent guardian of endings, delivered in a single brutal motion. It appears in an archive of duel-trials from a distant realm.

rites.name: Tonanum
rites.text: A second incantation spoken by a fiery seer to awaken her warrior guise. It appears across several retellings of her legend, including stage and screen adaptations.

rites.name: Orastia
rites.text: A coordinated strike that several fighters perform together, pairing two or three allies in one assault. It can inflict harm on foes or be used to shield the group from attacks.

rites.name: Ceollarium
rites.text: A bright curved burst of gathered light, loosed by a warrior in a clash of the eighth trial. It is a mighty energy strike hurled forward to overwhelm the foe.

rites.name: Tonia
rites.text: A radiant strike of luminous energy unleashed by a guardian of the night sky. It draws on four gathered shards of crystal to complete its shining surge.

rites.name: Vollanum
rites.text: A chanted phrase that draws on a luminous heart-stone to mend people who were turned against their nature and to rouse a sleeping sovereign. Its bearer can also invoke the stone's force without aiming it at any single blow.

rites.name: Ameolleria
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a warrior of the flame speaks to take on a battle form. It is the only words she ever needs for the change.

rites.name: Vosentum
rites.text: A water-borne strike drawn from a seafaring discipline, sharpened by a wrist-worn charm. It is a stronger variant of an older underwater technique.

rites.name: Corantinor
rites.text: A sealing charm cast by a sorceress that walls off a traveling tent, hiding its glow and blocking anyone from crossing time. The charm alerts its caster whenever someone tries to breach the barrier.

rites.name: Orantaullum
rites.text: A swift leaping flurry of blows delivered by a small young fighter while airborne. It is a close-quarters strike technique used in a single contest between two combatants.

rites.name: Tiarnia Teleolus
rites.text: A fighter drops low and sweeps a rotating leg through a crowd of foes at once. Each pass drains a little of the attacker's stamina.

rites.name: Oreolus
rites.text: A radiant strike is channeled through a crescent-tipped staff, sending a stream of rose-colored sparks toward a foe. A counter-blast of raw force erases it in an instant, and it is never used again.

rites.name: Telornanum
rites.text: A radiant energy technique wielded by a heroine to annihilate shadowy monsters sent by a dark realm. Over time a newer, more powerful technique replaces it as her chief weapon, though she still calls on it now and then.

rites.name: Corones
rites.text: A bright invoked strike drawn from a pale luminous gem, summoned by a wielder as a final appeal. It appears in two separate digital contests of combat and feeling.

rites.name: Serasor
rites.text: A combined strike of raw lightning woven together with engineered energy, unleashed by a skilled practitioner. It is known for its unusual force and is performed by a single figure across several retellings.

rites.name: Torauntium
rites.text: A ranked strike technique in which a fighter flings four tokens in sequence to deliver a combined blow. It is wielded by a masked duelist of a secret circle of trickster warriors.

rites.name: Cialastia
rites.text: A bright hymn that a young heroine sings to stir her inner spirit. It is sung in a style meant to reflect her personality.

rites.name: Ristes
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a young guardian speaks while holding a rose-hued moon gem, causing her to change into a stronger battle form. It is recorded in written tales and in a later visual retelling.

rites.name: Miallium
rites.text: A ruling sorceress hurls a massive burst of dark energy at a heroine during a staged performance. It is a forceful attack drawn from raw shadow.

rites.name: Orellanum
rites.text: A bearer speaks a final sacred phrase while holding a glowing relic, and the words awaken a radiant, ever-lasting guardian form. The incantation is recorded in both written scrolls and spoken chronicles.

rites.name: Orosialus
rites.text: A collective blast of energy that draws on several bearers acting together. It resembles a lesser combined strike, yet it hits far harder and with greater force.

rites.name: Ameonum
rites.text: A restorative art in which a ruler's tuned instrument is played to mend wounds and ease injuries. It is practiced only in the staged performances of the realm.

rites.name: Orillia
rites.text: A radiant technique performed by a royal warrior, channeled through a ceremonial blade. It appears only in one dramatized version of the saga.

rites.name: Rolium
rites.text: Two wielders join their crystal staffs in a sweeping combined strike of radiant color. It is a stronger evolution of an older joint technique once used by a single pair of fighters.

rites.name: Tolanum
rites.text: Tolanum was a sealing rite performed at the first crossing of the Veil-walls in Venuala's Walled Age, when order-keepers bound a breach with consecrated bronze and a single held breath. The working closed a rift that had drifted across three provinces and left the surrounding stone glassed and humming for a generation.

rites.name: Calauntium
rites.text: A duet of two voices that a pair of cosmic guardians sing together during a final movement. It stands as a shared hymn of guidance between a young luminous spirit and a distant keeper of endings.

rites.name: Nisor
rites.text: A whirling bodily strike performed by a small, youthful warrior during a contest of arms. It is one of the blows that such a fighter can deliver against foes.

rites.name: Castium
rites.text: A melody sung by two performers as a personal tune, once played briefly before a grand gathering began. Later one singer performs it alone during a practice, just before raising a sharp call at those who manage the lights.

rites.name: Meonaurnor
rites.text: A radiant technique drawn from lunar light and reflective glass, performed through a prism-like device. It fires a rainbow beam accompanied by bursts of shattered-glass energy, while the targets are framed against a flickering, mirror-like backdrop.

rites.name: Mistes
rites.text: A bearer of forgetting unleashes a sweeping assault that erases memories from those caught within its reach. The strike is wielded in a manga and an animated film.

rites.name: Vireostanum
rites.text: A bright, pulsing blast of stored energy is unleashed by a guardian warrior in the story. It strikes foes with a forceful wave of radiant power.

rites.name: Teleonus
rites.text: A chanted hymn of luminous resolve, written by a storyteller and shaped by a musician for a staged performance. It is sung to stir courage among the faithful.

rites.name: Maurnium
rites.text: A single flurry of radiant energy is unleashed by one wielder against a rival in a distant chronicle. It strikes once and is never seen again.

rites.name: Rollor
rites.text: A chant-song sung by four distant guardians of the outer heavens, sounded in two versions, one of which carries a charm-token's resonance.

rites.name: Valiarnasum
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a wielder uses to take on a sea-guardian form. It is recited in several retellings of the tale.

rites.name: Viastanes
rites.text: A melodic chant performed by a trio of celestial guardians during staged theatrical productions. It is heard in two separate stage performances tied to the legend of falling lights.

rites.name: Mollia
rites.text: A technique wielded by a small young warrior who channels a silvery light of the night sky. It is used as a special strike within a dramatic clash of heroes.

rites.name: Morinor
rites.text: A second chanted incantation that a young warrior speaks to change into her armored battle form. It has been recorded across several retellings of the tale in different media.

rites.name: Oriseria
rites.text: A spoken incantation lets a guardian change shape into a healing warrior. The chant comes in two forms, the later one being a more elaborate ritual.

rites.name: Neonaustia
rites.text: A narrow light-based strike hurled by a masked heroine in battle. Its form mirrors a broader crescent blast, adjusted to suit the moment against a heavy foe.

rites.name: Neollus
rites.text: A fighter hurls herself across the arena with a fist crackling with stored storm energy. She strikes her foe as a last-resort blow that leaves them jolted.

rites.name: Conium
rites.text: A stronger form of a guardian's craft is wakened when the bearer raises a hand and speaks a gifted phrase. The change happens at once, with no tool needed.

rites.name: Toleontus
rites.text: A spoken command that causes a heart-shaped ember charm to reshape into a star, letting its bearer join allies in a radiant transformation. The surge lends strength to a healing kiss that overcomes a sorceress queen.

rites.name: Riallanum
rites.text: A stronger form of a frosty bubble mist, this technique is unleashed by a water-wielding warrior and sealed onto a foe in a single decisive blast.

rites.name: Serillus
rites.text: A combined technique that gathers flowers and radiant energy into one violent gust. It is wielded by a dreamy royal protector who carries it across several retellings of her story.

rites.name: Serostor
rites.text: A radiant technique of luminous energy unleashed by a warrior who channels bright light. It is a signature strike used across many storytelling media.

rites.name: Rialum
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a young warrior speaks to change into a starlit battle form. The chant has two versions, with the later one more elaborate.

rites.name: Serniasium
rites.text: A fighter performs a spinning kick that can glide back and forth across the field. Weak strikes hit several times, while a strong one lands once, and good timing lets the user dodge incoming missiles.

rites.name: Orantus
rites.text: A deliberate striking maneuver performed by a sorceress during staged performances. It is used as her signature offensive technique against opponents on the stage.

rites.name: Amonium
rites.text: A tiny young wielder releases an exceptionally potent heart-shaped blast through a pink staff. It appears across many retellings of the legend.

rites.name: Valaurium
rites.text: A dark siege technique in which a caster and several servants drain the inner spark of defenders so they cannot take on their guardian forms. It is used to halt a group of champions mid-change.

rites.name: Meornium
rites.text: A frost-spell used once by a healer-maiden who hurls a rush of white flakes that coats a foe in ice. The chill barely slows the target, so the spell proves weak.

rites.name: Cestus
rites.text: A spoken incantation that lets a small young wielder transform into a tiny warrior form. The words are chanted to call up a hidden crystal light.

rites.name: Serillesia
rites.text: A small spoken incantation makes a companion creature reshape itself into a trinket for a friend. The gift was made to say goodbye before a long journey away.

rites.name: Serastanum
rites.text: A ballad performed by a healer-scholar during a moment of farewell. It is sung within a broadcast tale of a fallen companion's passing.

rites.name: Valolastia
rites.text: A spoken invocation that a sovereign of distant starlight recites to shift into her guardian shape. It is written in the bound chronicles and carried through the glowing crystal of the realm.

rites.name: Seronus
rites.text: A crackling storm-technique in which a warrior hurls a spinning gale charged with lightning at foes. It is wielded by a fighter who draws on sky-born power.

rites.name: Neonus
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a young heroine chants to change into her guardian form. It is the first activation phrase she learns and appears across every retelling of her story.

rites.name: Ameorium
rites.text: A ranged strike unleashed by a spellcaster during a digital contest. It hurls a concentrated burst of energy at a single foe in the arena.

rites.name: Coreornia
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a young heroine uses to change into a costumed guardian. It appears in a short comic tale about a parallel version of her life.

rites.name: Lentastia
rites.text: A powerful technique that bends the fabric of time and space to seal shut gateways between worlds. A caster can shut such passages from a distance.

rites.name: Viasium
rites.text: A spoken phrase that a young fighter uses to change into a storm-powered guardian. It is the third such incantation she learned during a long campaign.

rites.name: Rerania
rites.text: A guardian wielder conjures a shell of folded space around themselves to shield against harm. The barrier is drawn through a sight-lens worn over the eyes.

rites.name: Sontialium
rites.text: A spoken invocation that a warrior speaks to change her into a guardian form. It is the closing words of her transformation rite, shown across several retellings of her story.

rites.name: Nolanum Tauntisum
rites.text: A spoken invocation lets a wielder reshape themselves into a radiant guardian. The chant can unfold in a plainer form or a grander one, with the fuller version reserved for a single rare occasion.

rites.name: Volor
rites.text: A bearer lifts a silver-lit staff, spins it around the body, and then releases a radiant heart-shaped burst that shatters a monstrous shadow creature.

rites.name: Valaunum
rites.text: A fighter channels living growth and crackling lightning into one devastating blast. It is the strongest single strike her wielder can unleash, reshaping the battlefield around her.

rites.name: Mantum
rites.text: A dim, charged surge unleashed as a strike by the servants of a shadowy ruler. It appears in a staged performance about a legendary island.

rites.name: Ralaustum
rites.text: A spoken phrase that lets a young woman change her form into a guardian of water and wisdom. It is the second of the words she uses for the transformation.

rites.name: Sorirnanum
rites.text: A spoken invocation that a young scholar speaks to change herself into a guardian of water and thought. It is the first phrase she uses for this transformation, and it appears in several retellings of her story.

rites.name: Telistor
rites.text: A bright performance piece that a cosmic villain sings as her signature showcase. It presents her image to audiences through music.

rites.name: Orelonum
rites.text: A radiant lattice of curved luminous shafts is unleashed in a single sweeping volley. It appears only once, in one chapter of a long-running saga.

rites.name: Sostor
rites.text: A water-born strike channeled by a sea-attuned fighter through gathered crystal sparks. It needs four such sparks to be unleashed in a single blow.

rites.name: Vellia
rites.text: A dark, defiant chant sung by a band of night-born blood-hunters during a stage battle in a shadowed forest. It is performed again in a later revised staging.

rites.name: Oreonus
rites.text: A keeper of the hourglass wields a sealed chant to change her form into a guardian of time. It is the first such invocation she speaks, and the only one ever seen in use.

rites.name: Coreorium
rites.text: A melody that three wandering guardians sing while searching for the one they serve. Listeners say it carries a strong feeling of love, and the guardians use it to express both their longing and their sorrow.

rites.name: Tausia
rites.text: A spoken command that a heroine uses to channel a sacred vessel and transform into a stronger form. A smaller companion can also invoke the same words to achieve a similar change.

rites.name: Renauntium
rites.text: A spoken incantation that lets a bound young scholar shed her ordinary guise and take on a sinister, borrowed form. It is worked through a dark wristlet of woven silver charms.

rites.name: Reollonanum
rites.text: A dark strike is unleashed by a masked brute during a staged performance. It is aimed at a group of heroic defenders and their ally.

rites.name: Ciseonum
rites.text: A closing incantation spoken by a young scholar that transforms her into a protective guardian. It is recited in several retellings of the tale, across print, animation, and staged performances.

rites.name: Amesilum
rites.text: A violent surge of water erupts from a vast cosmic force and is unleashed by a warrior of sea and song. It serves as a signature assault used across several retellings of her story.

rites.name: Orilorus
rites.text: A radiant energy technique wielded by a warrior of a stage performance troupe. It was described in an archive of production notes, yet it was never shown in action.

rites.name: Maurneores
rites.text: A melodic chant performed by a choir of moon-singers. It appears on a recording named for the power of the night sky.

rites.name: Teliraulum
rites.text: A melodic opening piece was created for a foreign-language broadcast of a magical girl serial. Its original title means that a moonlit tale is told.

rites.name: Telaunium
rites.text: A spoken incantation that a young girl recites to shift into her ordinary guardian costume, revealing her secret second self. It marks the moment her everyday identity gives way to the hidden warrior within.

rites.name: Coraneollia
rites.text: A chanted melody performed by a band of wandering musicians, sung to affirm a listener's own worth. It is a song whose verses encourage every hearer to answer yes to themselves.

rites.name: Coriaranum
rites.text: A heroine delivers a powerful kick to her foe. The strike is modeled on an older fighter's signature blow and appears across several retellings of her story.

rites.name: Amestia
rites.text: A chanted incantation that a young guardian speaks to shift her body into a powerful protective form. It appears across comics, a glowing gem, and stage performances.

rites.name: Ryimwen
rites.text: Ryimwen is a mythic transmutation that turns ordinary matter into a shimmering lattice of light and shadow, allowing its bearer to weave time‑tangled corridors. In the era of E6, the lattice is sought as a key to unlock the forgotten gates of the Ki realm. Its emergence is whispered to herald a new epoch of balance between creation and dissolution.

rites.name: Miinneth
rites.text: Miinneth is a sky-bonded sentinel of the Ki realm, long mistaken for an ordinary bird perched on a sacred hillside. Within her chest she carries a luminous ember that answers the call of a kindred guardian, and she shields her chosen ward with wings that bend light itself.

rites.name: Nuemuarla
rites.text: Nuemuarla is a Ki-realm concept in the Venuala omniverse, a guardian bound to a shrine's sacred flame and sworn to shield its keeper from harm. In the sixth era, when the realm's lattice of spirit-rivers was still young, Nuemuarla could bend a flare of ember-light large enough to scorch a star's corona.

rites.name: Elalys
rites.text: Elalys is a concept-born star-singer of the Ki realm, a luminous being who wanders the void for a bloom worthy of her devotion. Her gentle bond with a human child in the Venuala system was her first true anchor, and her drifting search remains the spine of her story.

rites.name: Nuarlae
rites.text: Nuarlae is a root-binding concept in Venuala's Ki realm, a power that coaxes the vital glow out of living things and grows it into sprawling blossoms across the land. It is studied in the sixth era as both a gift of renewal and a warning about what happens when harvested vitality is never returned.

rites.name: Lyiruaneth
rites.text: Lyiruaneth is a crystalline sentinel of the Venuala's outer cold, a concept given form as a drifting lattice of frozen memory. She tends the dormant reservoirs of primordial rime that lie scattered across the ancient ice belts of her realm. Her faint, endless vigil keeps the stellar frost from warming into rebirth.

rites.name: Sinantes
rites.text: A cosmic energy assault wielded by a band of shadowed warriors, controlled through hidden strings of power. It is unleashed during staged performances and grand celestial battles.

rites.name: Oraullium
rites.text: A starborn warrior of inner circles releases a sweeping wave of radiant force drawn from the cosmos. It appears in the chronicles and in the late cosmic saga.

rites.name: Casiaranum
rites.text: A coordinated blast of cosmic energy unleashed by a team of celestial defenders, excluding their two leaders. It appears in written tales and the animated film.

rites.name: Ciaraunanum
rites.text: A cosmic power drawn from energy that swells outward, used by a wandering star-sworn seeker. It appears in written tales, a later film, and staged performances.

rites.name: Telintialum
rites.text: A celestial hymn that is sung as the emblem of a cosmic sovereign. It is given voice to express the character tied to it.

rites.name: Vineontum
rites.text: A cosmic wave of force that a wandering star-warden unleashes as a devastating assault. It is wielded in several retellings of the tale, each showing its raw power.

rites.name: Telines
rites.text: A starborn tempest is unleashed by a wrist-worn charm that amplifies the wielder's power. It appears in later chapters and in a film, striking with cosmic force.

rites.name: Niastarnum
rites.text: Two celestial guardians join their light into a single devastating surge of energy. The combined strike is channeled through a shared focus to overwhelm foes.

rites.name: Telisia
rites.text: A bright energy technique that a band of cosmic guardians unleashes in staged performances only. It channels radiant power outward from the caster as a single focused blast.

rites.name: Serenia
rites.text: A circle of guardians stands with clasped hands and instantly moves the whole group to any chosen place. The destination can be deep underground, the open surface, or a region of distant space.
